deployments_detail.use: PD Loss predictive ML model that analyzes hundreds of variables from patient health records (adherence, fluid removal, blood pressure, cycler device data) to flag peritoneal-dialysis patients at high risk of dropping off home dialysis within 90 days, prompting weekly targeted interventions. deployments_detail.value: ~15% lower risk of transferring to in-center hemodialysis when nurses intervene within 5 days of a high-risk flag; PD-to-HHD mean transition time 6 days

DaVita invested via DaVita Venture Group. [Linea (DaVita Venture Group investment)]
deployments_detail.value: 50% reduction in hospital readmissions; <25% 90-day readmission rate; 80% patient engagement before discharge (early pilot results)
